title: Network security groups
summary: A network security group contains rules that allow or deny network traffic. Rules have priorities, so their order matters.
introduction: A network security group contains rules that allow or deny network traffic. Rules have priorities, so their order matters. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A network security group contains rules that allow or deny network traffic. Rules have priorities, so their order matters.

blocks.code:
Rule priority 100: allow approved HTTPS traffic
Later rules: handle other traffic according to the plan
blocks.title: Network security groups

blocks.text: A smaller priority number is processed before a larger one. The full rule set determines the result.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.

blocks.text: Do not open every port to the internet to make troubleshooting easier.
